Defend the center by all means necessary!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[D00M's Revenge]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Ducky D00M''' was the final boss for [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. It held a very high amount of health with an above average speed. Uniquely, it could not spawn until the last plot of land was cleared, which prevented it from spawning in perpetuity. '''Ducky D00M''' is unique in that, like [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]], it did not directly try to reach the base. Instead, it would circle around the map, firing off its abilities, only directly attacking the base with its ''Chainsaw Dash'' ability. #'''Ducky D00M''' had seven abilities. Its first ability, the ''Rocket Barrage'' ability, caused '''Ducky D00M''' to fire off a barrage of rockets in certain directions. Towers caught in the rockets' explosions were stunned. This could only happen during its ''Rage Mode'' ability. #Its second ability, the ''Chainsaw Dash'' ability, made it retract out two chainsaws as it charged towards the base, dealing 100 damage, and stunned any towers that it ran over during this ability. #Its third ability, the ''Trundle'' ability, was a passive ability that simply caused towers to be stunned if run over by '''Ducky D00M'''. #Its fourth ability, the ''Minigun Spray'' attack, made '''Ducky D00M''' spray its miniguns at towers, which stunned them. This could only happen during its ''Rage Mode'' ability. #Its fifth ability, the ''Nerd n' Shotgun'' ability, caused '''Ducky D00M''' to fire its side guns, which shot out bullets in a shotgun-like fashion, which stunned towers and dealt at least 50 damage to units. #Its sixth ability, the ''Nerd Laughter'' ability, caused '''Ducky D00M''' (or the "nerd") to squeal loudly, which simply shook the camera, disorienting players. #Its seventh and final ability is its ''Rage Mode'' ability. At half health, it gained its ability to use the ''Rocket Barrage'' and ''Minigun Spray'' attacks mentioned before. Three [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]]s were also spawned in when ''Rage Mode'' was activated. ==Appearance== '''Ducky D00M''' was a giant robot duck armored with steel plates. On its head there were two big red horns and two smaller ones behind it. It had glowing red eyes and an orange beak. On its stomach was a hatch, which when opened showed a yellow duck with black eyes, orange beak and black glasses that controlled '''Ducky D00M''' using numerous levers inside of the torso. The duck that controlled '''Ducky D00M''' was described as a "nerd". It walked with treaded feet, with legs that could extract. On its wings, there were two blasters that were used to attack towers. There were also two miniguns and two quad missile launchers under its wings. Upon activating ''Rage Mode'', '''Ducky D00M's''' body extended itself further from the tread-tracks. ==Strategy== *It is recommended to stall '''Ducky D00M''' from spawning to give yourself more time to place and upgrade towers. **You can stall '''Ducky D00M's''' spawn by leaving one plot of land not purchased. You can purchase it later when you are ready. **This is generally not necessary, as you will get a lot of cash from '''Ducky D00M''' itself along with passive income. ***Do note that, if you decide to stall the game for about half an hour, the game will begin spawning only [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]]s, which combined with their absurdly high health will render the game practically impossible. *Due to its ''Chainsaw Dash'' ability, it is recommended to keep as much health as possible. It is not recommended to let some enemies leak early on due to this ability. **Placing [[Medic]]s earlier on to heal any lost health ensures that enough health may be kept for the ''Chainsaw Dash''. **However, do note that after '''Ducky D00M''' spawns, no more health can be healed back. *Towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], and [[Accelerator]] are highly recommended for defeating '''Ducky D00M'''. **The [[Commander]] can be used to decrease the firerate of these towers. Its ''Call to Arms'' ability should be used when '''Ducky D00M''' is in range of your towers. **Additionally, the [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful in increasing these towers' range so that '''Ducky D00M''' stays in the range of your towers for longer. *The [[Ranger]] is highly recommended as '''Ducky D00M''' often walks out of range of most ground towers. The [[Ranger]] has a high enough range to cover the whole map and constantly attack '''Ducky D00M'''. **The [[Pursuit]] can also be useful as its large circling range allows it to reach '''Ducky D00M''' while it is in the outskirts of the map. **They are recommended to be set to ''Strongest'' to help kill '''Ducky D00M''' faster instead of wasting shots on weaker enemies. *The [[Medic]] can be very useful at cleansing stuns caused by '''Ducky D00M''' and other enemies, such as from [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]] or the [[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckHuntEvent.png|'''Ducky D00M''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckyD00MPI.png|'''Ducky D00M''' on a promotional image. LegacyDuckyD00MIconIG.png|'''Ducky D00M''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *'''Ducky D00M''' is a new version of [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]] that appeared in [[Eggy Island]] during [[Spring 2020 Event]], which is controlled by [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]]'s son (the "nerd") that has come for revenge. *'''Ducky D00M''' has the fastest speed for a major boss in the game, beating even the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] during its ''Void's Deathwish'' ability. *'''Ducky D00M''' could destroy objects on the [[D00M's Revenge]] map by running into them. These included the trees and the table with a sign listing prices for food. This was purely visual and did not affect gameplay. *The objective dialogue states to defeat the duck that controls '''Ducky D00M''', which it described as a "nerd", instead of '''Ducky D00M''' itself. *'''Ducky D00M''' is currently tied with [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from [[Krampus Frosthold]] and [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] for the second most abilities in the game, only behind the [[Frost Spirit]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''Ducky D00M''' is the first enemy to have an ability that only affects players and not the towers. *When '''Ducky D00M''' was defeated, the "nerd" would be flung out of it. ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Ducky D00M''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Ducky D00M''' removed. ==Notes== {{D00MRevenge2|[[Long Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Long Ducky]]
